passage.quote:
The specification is authored using upstream TorchLean's `nn.Sequential`, with
a linear layer from shape `[1024]` to `[3072]` followed by ReLU.

summary: Define the upstream TorchLean sequential linear/ReLU architecture, its explicit weight-then-bias state, and its evaluation-mode forward program from shape [1024] to [3072].
Use the same named concrete input and output dimensions in the Sequential architecture and selected PTX layout/launch.

from.quote:
The Lean package pins TorchLean and its transitive dependencies and contains no
dependency on the PTXLean package.

passage.quote:
name = "ptxlean_relu_layer"
version = "0.1.0"
fixedToolchain = true
defaultTargets = ["ReluLayer"]

[[require]]
name = "TorchLean"
git = "https://github.com/lean-dojo/TorchLean.git"
rev = "de3192df4779877ceb65cfe470a4d4ce9d480a5b"

# FloatLib is used directly by the kernel's binary32 arithmetic adapter.
[[require]]
name = "floatlib"
git = "https://github.com/lean-dojo/FloatLib"
rev = "c9a051f08f948ce473036b815b0669fafb61f601"

# Root pins select one compatible dependency graph for all packages.
[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4"
rev = "v4.35.0-rc4"

[[require]]
name = "doc-gen4"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover/doc-gen4"
rev = "v4.35.0-rc4"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "ReluLayer"
moreLeanArgs = ["-M5120"]

from.quote:
The shared `inputSize` and `outputSize` define the concrete dimensions, 1024
and 3072, for both the specification and PTX layout/launch.

passage.quote:
namespace ReluLayer

/-- Shared concrete dimensions of the Sequential specification and selected PTX kernel. -/
abbrev inputSize : Nat := 1024
abbrev outputSize : Nat := 3072

end ReluLayer

from.quote:
The layer's architecture is an upstream TorchLean `nn.Sequential [1024] [3072]`
containing `nn.linear 1024 3072` followed by `nn.relu`. The linear layer owns a
weight tensor of shape `[3072, 1024]` and a bias tensor of shape `[3072]`. ReLU
has no parameter state.

passage.quote:
import ReluLayer.Dimensions
import NN.API.Macros
import NN.API.Seeded

namespace ReluLayer

open TorchLean

/-- A linear layer with bias, followed by elementwise ReLU. -/
def architecture : nn.Builder (nn.Sequential [inputSize] [outputSize]) :=
  nn.Sequential![
    nn.linear inputSize outputSize,
    nn.relu
  ]

/-- Build the architecture; forward evaluation receives its parameters separately. -/
def model : nn.Sequential [inputSize] [outputSize] :=
  nn.build 0 architecture

/-- The linear layer owns weights and bias, in that order; ReLU adds no state. -/
theorem state_shapes : nn.stateShapes model = [[outputSize, inputSize], [outputSize]] := by
  rfl

/-- Supply arbitrary weights and bias instead of using initialized model state. -/
def parameters {α : Type} [Storage α]
    (W : Tensor α [outputSize, inputSize]) (b : Tensor α [outputSize]) :
    nn.State α (nn.stateShapes model) :=
  (nn.State.empty.push W).push b

/-- The upstream sequential forward program takes W, b, and x and returns y. -/
def forwardProgram {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α] :
    Runtime.Autograd.Model.Program α [[outputSize, inputSize], [outputSize], [inputSize]]
        [outputSize] :=
  model.forward .eval

end ReluLayer
